lines.zh: 先看一个荒唐的比喻：每招一个岗位，就重办一所大学。
lines.en: A job opening, and we build a whole university for it.

lines.zh: 2017 年之前，自然语言处理差不多就是这样。
lines.en: Before 2017, natural language processing mostly looked like that.

lines.zh: 每个任务收一份标注数据，训一个模型，只解决这一件事。
lines.en: One labelled set, one model, one task, and nothing more.

lines.zh: 换任务就得重训，学到的语言知识一点也带不走。
lines.en: Change the task, retrain, and none of the language knowledge follows.

lines.zh: 标注还是最贵的一环：一条数据要人读、人判、人填。
lines.en: Labels cost the most: a human reads, judges and fills each one in.

lines.zh: 这一章讲：怎么绕开标注，先读书，再做题。
lines.en: This chapter: skip the labels, read first, then do the exercises.

lines.zh: 所以瓶颈不在模型，而在数据：标注太贵了。
lines.en: So the bottleneck is not the model. It is the labels.

lines.zh: 几万条标注听着不少，其实只够一个很窄的任务。
lines.en: Tens of thousands of labels still cover only one narrow task.

lines.zh: 任务一换，这份数据就作废，模型也要跟着重训。
lines.en: Switch the task and the data is dead; the model is retrained.

lines.zh: 情感分析、命名实体、问答、翻译，各要一套。
lines.en: Sentiment, entities, question answering, translation: one set each.

lines.zh: 但另一边，无标注的文本是取之不尽的。
lines.en: Meanwhile, unlabelled text never runs out.

lines.zh: 互联网上有几万亿 token，它们本身就是答案。
lines.en: Trillions of tokens on the web are already their own answers.

scenes.en: LET THE TEXT SET THE QUIZ

lines.zh: 自监督的想法很朴素：从文本里挖掉一部分。
lines.en: Self-supervision starts simply: remove part of a text.

lines.zh: 让模型去补，补对了算对，补错了就改参数。
lines.en: Let the model fill it back; right answers keep it, wrong ones move weights.

lines.zh: 因为原文就是标准答案，一个标注工都不用请。
lines.en: The original text is the answer key, so no labeller is ever hired.

lines.zh: 这一招有两个版本，分歧决定了后来五年的走向。
lines.en: Two versions emerged, and their split shaped the next five years.

lines.zh: 版本 A 是自回归：给定前面的词，预测下一个词。
lines.en: Version A is autoregressive: given the words before, predict the next.

lines.zh: 这就是第 1 章的语言模型目标，一字未改。
lines.en: That is the language model objective from Chapter 1, unchanged.

lines.zh: 它天然从左到右，只能看见已经写出来的部分。
lines.en: It reads left to right, seeing only what has already been written.

lines.zh: 版本 B 是掩码：随机挖掉句子里百分之十五的词。
lines.en: Version B is masking: hide fifteen percent of the words at random.

lines.zh: 让模型根据左右两边，把它们填回原来的位置。
lines.en: The model fills them back using both sides of the sentence.

lines.zh: 这叫掩码语言模型，本质上是一道完形填空题。
lines.en: This is the masked language model, a cloze test at scale.

lines.zh: 两条路线看的方向不同，训练信号也不同。
lines.en: The two routes differ in what they see and what trains them.

lines.zh: 自回归只看左边，每个位置都要预测下一个词。
lines.en: Autoregression sees only the left, and predicts at every position.

lines.zh: 掩码左右都看，但只有百分之十五的位置有信号。
lines.en: Masking sees both sides, but only fifteen percent of positions signal.

lines.zh: 2018 年 6 月，OpenAI 的 GPT-1 给出了完整配方。
lines.en: In June 2018, OpenAI's GPT-1 published a complete recipe.

lines.zh: 第一步，生成式预训练：十二层 Transformer 解码器。
lines.en: Step one, generative pre-training: a twelve-layer Transformer decoder.

lines.zh: 约一点一七亿参数，在七千本未出版的书上做下一词预测。
lines.en: About 117 million parameters, predicting the next word in 7000 books.

lines.zh: 第二步，判别式微调：接一个小分类头，用少量标注数据。
lines.en: Step two, discriminative fine-tuning: a small head and a little labelled data.

lines.zh: 在蕴含、问答、情感分类这些任务上，分别微调一遍。
lines.en: Entailment, question answering, sentiment: one pass of tuning each.

lines.zh: 十二个任务里，有九个刷新了当时的纪录。
lines.en: It beat the record on nine of twelve tasks.

lines.zh: 更重要的是它证明：语言知识是可以迁移的。
lines.en: More important, it showed that language knowledge can be transferred.

lines.zh: 四个月后，2018 年 10 月，Google 的 BERT 登场。
lines.en: Four months later, in October 2018, Google's BERT arrived.

lines.zh: 结构换成编码器，没有因果掩码，可以看全句。
lines.en: The structure is an encoder, no causal mask, so it sees the whole sentence.

lines.zh: 目标有两个：挖掉百分之十五的词来填，再判断两句是否连续。
lines.en: Two goals: fill in fifteen percent of words, and tell if two sentences connect.

lines.zh: 数据是书籍语料加英文维基百科，约三十三亿词。
lines.en: Training data: book corpus plus English Wikipedia, about 3.3 billion words.

lines.zh: Base 一点一亿参数，Large 三点四亿参数。
lines.en: Base has 110 million parameters; Large has 340 million.

lines.zh: 它在十一个自然语言处理任务上全面刷新了最好成绩。
lines.en: It set a new state of the art on eleven NLP tasks.

scenes.en: STRONG AT READING, WEAK AT WRITING

lines.zh: 双向的好处，在理解类任务上表现得最明显。
lines.en: The gain from both directions shows up in understanding tasks.

lines.zh: 判断 bank 是河岸还是银行，左右两边都用得上。
lines.en: Telling river bank from money bank uses words on both sides.

lines.zh: 被训练成一台上下文填空机，它自然擅长分类和抽取。
lines.en: Trained as a context-filling machine, it is good at classification and extraction.

lines.zh: 但它的训练目标和生成不匹配，这是个结构性缺陷。
lines.en: But its objective does not match generation. That is a structural flaw.

lines.zh: 它见过的是被挖了洞的句子，擅长填空，不擅长写文章。
lines.en: It has only seen sentences with holes: good at filling, bad at writing.

lines.zh: 你可以用它做分类，但不能拿它来聊天。
lines.en: You can classify with it, but you cannot chat with it.

lines.zh: 一条路线擅长理解，另一条路线擅长生成。
lines.en: One route is strong at reading, the other at writing.

lines.zh: 2019 年 2 月，OpenAI 发布 GPT-2，十五亿参数。
lines.en: In February 2019, OpenAI released GPT-2 with 1.5 billion parameters.

lines.zh: 大约是 GPT-1 的十三倍，数据是四十 GB 的网页文本。
lines.en: About thirteen times GPT-1, trained on 40 GB of web text.

lines.zh: 论文标题说：语言模型是无监督的多任务学习器。
lines.en: The paper's title: language models are unsupervised multitask learners.

lines.zh: 意思是，训练数据里本来就有翻译、问答、摘要和代码。
lines.en: The training text already holds translation, QA, summaries and code.

lines.zh: 一个足够大的模型，可能没针对任何任务训练过。
lines.en: A large enough model may never have been trained on any task.

lines.zh: 把任务写成一段提示，让它接着写，这叫零样本。
lines.en: Write the task as a prompt and let it continue. That is zero-shot.

lines.zh: 不改架构，不加任务头，续写这一个接口吃掉所有任务。
lines.en: Same architecture, no task head: one interface eats all tasks.

lines.zh: 这个两段式，可以用一个古老的教育模型来理解。
lines.en: This two-stage recipe maps onto an old model of education.

lines.zh: 预训练像通识教育，学语言的一般规律和世界知识。
lines.en: Pre-training is liberal arts: general patterns of language and the world.

lines.zh: 数据海量、无标注、便宜，目标是学会世界如何运转。
lines.en: Data is huge, unlabelled and cheap; the goal is how the world works.

lines.zh: 微调像职业培训，学具体任务的输入输出格式。
lines.en: Fine-tuning is vocational training: the input-output format of one job.

lines.zh: 数据少量、有标注、很贵，目标是学会这个岗位怎么做。
lines.en: Data is small, labelled and costly; the goal is how this job is done.

lines.zh: 通用机床加专用夹具，也比每个零件造一台机床便宜。
lines.en: A general machine tool plus a jig beats one machine per part.

lines.zh: 类比失效的地方在于：通识毕业并不能直接上岗。
lines.en: The analogy breaks where a graduate still cannot start the job.

lines.zh: 但模型足够大时，提示里给几个例子就能现学，微调被跳过。
lines.en: But a big enough model learns from examples in the prompt, skipping tuning.

lines.zh: 到 2019 年底，BERT 如日中天，GPT-2 只是有趣。
lines.en: By late 2019 BERT was dominant and GPT-2 merely interesting.

lines.zh: 但从 2020 年起，天平彻底倒向自回归这一边。
lines.en: From 2020 on, the balance tipped fully to autoregression.

lines.zh: 第一个原因：接口统一，任何任务都能写成给上文、续写。
lines.en: First reason: one interface. Any task is context in, continuation out.

lines.zh: 分类、翻译、写代码、做数学题，都是同一句话。
lines.en: Classification, translation, code, maths: all the same sentence.

lines.zh: 而填空的接口，很难覆盖生成类的任务。
lines.en: A fill-in-the-blank interface struggles to cover generation.

lines.zh: 第二个原因：可扩展，自回归每个位置都有训练信号。
lines.en: Second reason: scalability. Autoregression signals at every position.

lines.zh: 掩码只有百分之十五的位置有信号，数据利用率差近七倍。
lines.en: Masking signals only fifteen percent, nearly seven times less use of data.

lines.zh: 第三个原因：规模一大，通用目标开始逼出任务能力。
lines.en: Third reason: at scale, the general objective forces out task ability.

lines.zh: 预训练不是免费的午餐，它带来三个新问题。
lines.en: Pre-training is not a free lunch. It brings three new problems.

lines.zh: 第一，数据截止：模型只知道截止日期前的世界。
lines.en: First, knowledge cutoff: it knows only the world before its data ends.

lines.zh: 第二，分布偏移：语料是平均的互联网，你的任务可能很窄。
lines.en: Second, distribution shift: the corpus is the average web, your task narrow.

lines.zh: 第三，无法追溯：很难知道某个事实是从哪段文本学来的。
lines.en: Third, no provenance: you cannot tell which text taught it a fact.

lines.zh: 这既是版权问题，也是模型的可解释性问题。
lines.en: That is both a copyright problem and an explainability problem.

lines.zh: 模型足够大时，微调会变得不必要，范式转向提示。
lines.en: When models get big enough, tuning fades and the paradigm turns to prompts.

lines.zh: 把三次发布排成一条线，转向就看清楚了。
lines.en: Line up the three releases and the turn becomes visible.

lines.zh: 2018 年 6 月，GPT-1 把预训练和微调接了起来。
lines.en: June 2018: GPT-1 joined pre-training to fine-tuning.

lines.zh: 同年 10 月，BERT 用双向掩码在理解任务上全面领先。
lines.en: October 2018: BERT led on understanding with bidirectional masking.

lines.zh: 2019 年 2 月，GPT-2 押注零样本，当时并不起眼。
lines.en: February 2019: GPT-2 bet on zero-shot, and looked unremarkable.

lines.zh: 监督的瓶颈是标注，自监督用文本自身绕开了它。
lines.en: Supervision was bottlenecked by labels; self-supervision used the text.

lines.zh: 预训练加微调，等于通识加职业培训，知识可以迁移。
lines.en: Pre-train then fine-tune: liberal arts then vocational, knowledge transfers.

lines.zh: 胜负手不是谁更聪明，而是谁更容易规模化。
lines.en: The winner was not the smarter one, but the one easier to scale.

lines.zh: 这一章留下的问题很直接：规模一大，能力为什么冒出来。
lines.en: The question left open is direct: why does ability appear as scale grows?

lines.zh: GPT-2 之后，OpenAI 把同样的配方放大了约一百倍。
lines.en: After GPT-2, OpenAI scaled the same recipe about a hundredfold.

lines.zh: 结果不只是更好，还出现了没人训练过的能力。
lines.en: The result was not just better: abilities nobody trained appeared.

lines.zh: 下一章讲规模定律，以及它划出的边界。
lines.en: Next chapter: scaling laws, and the limits they draw.

lines.zh: 先读书，再做题；下一步，是把书读得更大。
lines.en: Read first, then practise. Next, read on a much larger scale.
